Sana Patel  
Frontend Engineer | VitalCare Health  
Email: sana.patel@example.com | Phone: +972-52-123-4567 | Location: Tel Aviv, Israel  

A frontend engineer with 2 years of experience in healthtech, specializing in building accessible, responsive, and scalable web applications. My work focuses on creating seamless user experiences that align with the mission of improving healthcare accessibility. I thrive in collaborative environments where technical precision meets user-centric design, contributing to projects that prioritize both functionality and inclusivity.  

**Projects**  
At HealthTrack Solutions, I led the redesign of their patient dashboard, migrating legacy components to React and TypeScript. This effort reduced load times by 30% and improved accessibility compliance, enabling 15% more users to navigate the interface effectively. At VitalCare Health, I developed a real-time telehealth interface using Next.js, which streamlined video consultations and reduced onboarding time for clinicians by 25%. The project also integrated web accessibility standards, ensuring compatibility with screen readers and keyboard navigation.  

**Professional Experience**  
*Frontend Engineer* | VitalCare Health (2023–Present)  
Focused on modernizing their digital health platform, I spearheaded the implementation of a state management system using Zustand, which simplified data flow across complex UI components. My work on the telehealth interface involved optimizing React components for performance, reducing bundle size by 18% through code splitting. I also collaborated with UX designers to ensure responsive design principles were embedded in all interactions, resulting in a 20% increase in user retention for mobile users.  

*Junior Frontend Developer* | HealthTrack Solutions (2022)  
Contributed to the development of a centralized health data portal, where I implemented React-based dashboards for tracking patient vitals. By adopting TypeScript, I improved code maintainability and reduced bug rates by 12%. I also led a project to refactor legacy HTML/CSS into a modular component structure, which enhanced collaboration with backend teams and accelerated feature deployment.  

*Frontend Intern* | HealthTech Innovations (2021)  
Supported the development of a wearable health monitor’s companion app, where I focused on creating responsive UIs for both desktop and mobile platforms. My work on accessibility features, such as ARIA labels and color contrast adjustments, ensured compliance with WCAG 2.1 standards. This experience laid the foundation for my later work in inclusive design practices.  

**Education**  
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science | University of California, San Diego (2021–2022)  
Focused on full-stack development and human-computer interaction, with coursework in web technologies, algorithms, and usability studies. Graduated with honors, emphasizing hands-on projects that bridged theoretical knowledge with real-world applications.  

**Technical Skills**  
- **React**: Built core components for multiple health platforms, ensuring scalability and performance.  
- **Next.js**: Developed server-rendered pages for VitalCare’s telehealth system, improving SEO and load times.  
- **TypeScript**: Enhanced type safety in HealthTrack’s codebase, reducing runtime errors.  
- **Responsive Design**: Implemented adaptive layouts for cross-device usability, including mobile-first approaches.  
- **Web Accessibility (WCAG)**: Integrated ARIA roles and keyboard navigation into all major features.  
- **State Management**: Utilized Redux and Zustand to manage complex data flows in large-scale applications.  
- **REST API Design**: Collaborated on API integrations for patient data retrieval, ensuring clear endpoints and documentation.  
- **Test Automation**: Wrote unit tests for critical components, increasing coverage from 60% to 85%.  

**Languages**  
- English (native)  
- Hebrew (basic)
